controller_actions.task: Rewrite module.py implementing solve(data) per the user contract. Validate data is a dict with 'base' and 'patch' both dicts, else raise ValueError. Deep merge patch into base without mutating inputs (deepcopy values): for each patch key: value None -> remove key from result (no-op if absent); if base key absent -> insert patch value as is (deep-copied; note a nested None inside an inserted object is kept as is); if both dicts -> recurse with same rules; both lists -> patch list replaces; otherwise if types differ raise ValueError, where types are dict, list, str, bool, number (int/float but not bool) and bool != number; same type non-container (str, bool, number) -> patch value replaces. Key order: base keys in original order, then patch-only keys in patch order. Use only the standard library (no I/O, no dynamic code execution). Note: a base value of None with a non-null patch value is a different JSON type from anything except null; treat null type as its own type so mismatched raises ValueError.

Expectations must match the contract. Cover: null removes existing key; null for absent key is a no-op; nested object recursive merge; list replaces list entirely (no concatenation); absent base key inserts patch value as is; type mismatch (string vs number, bool vs number, object vs list) -> error ValueError; non-object base or patch -> error ValueError; key order is base keys first then patch-only keys in patch order.
